$comment: Known violations of scripts/check-spec-coherence.mjs (srs#560), each citing the live issue that removes it. Entry shape: {check, id | pair:[sourceId,targetId], issue, note}. The check fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry that no longer matches a violation — shrinking this file IS the migration (#562 un-bakes headings, #563 wires the tree, #564 makes invariants leaves). Growing it needs an issue. `note` is for the human reader only; the key is check + id/pair.
